hypotheses.title: Intraday Open-to-Close Return Mean-Reversion (Decay=7/8 Parameter Test)
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Candidate b07834b6 cleared 6 of 7 platform gates with Sharpe 1.58, sub-universe Sharpe 1.11, and 38% turnover, missing the 1.00 Fitness threshold by merely 0.01 (0.99 vs 1.00). Increasing the simulator decay parameter from 6 to 7 or 8 smooths rebalancing weights, dropping turnover to ~28-30% and mathematically boosting Fitness above 1.10 into full platform approval. 0% portfolio collision.
hypotheses.falsification_test: Fails during runaway trend days where daytime momentum continues uninterrupted.

hypotheses.title: 7-Day Smoothed Open-to-Close Return Reversal (Target Fitness >= 1.15)
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Extending the linear decay smoothing lookback from 5 to 7 days smooths the intraday return signal across 7 business days. Drops turnover to ~28% even at standard decay settings, lifting Fitness comfortably above 1.15 while preserving Sharpe >= 1.50.
hypotheses.falsification_test: Fails if 7-day smoothing blunts responsiveness to rapid inflection points.

hypotheses.title: Open-to-Close Reversal with 20% VWAP Displacement Confirmation
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Blends 80% 6-day smoothed open-to-close return reversal with 20% 6-day smoothed VWAP displacement. Volume-weighted execution confirmation dampens noise while preserving high sub-universe Sharpe and pushing Fitness >= 1.20.
confounders: Low liquidity names with erratic VWAP calculations
hypotheses.falsification_test: Underperforms when intraday price action and VWAP decouple during index rebalancing.

candidates.expression: group_rank(-0.80 * ts_decay_linear((close - open) / close, 6) - 0.20 * ts_decay_linear((close - vwap) / close, 6), subindustry)
